blueprint_concepts: PS = e PM form for a conic

concept_use.PS = e PM form for a conic: PS = e PM form for a conic at the two given points, with M the foot on the directrix x = d, gives 5|15 + d| = 17|5 - d| and the two candidate conics.

english: An ellipse has a focus at the origin, and the directrix corresponding to this focus is perpendicular to the $x$-axis. The ellipse passes through the points $(5,0)$ and $(-15,8)$. Then the eccentricity of the ellipse is ______.
hindi: एक दीर्घवृत्त की एक नाभि मूलबिन्दु पर है, तथा इस नाभि के संगत नियता $x$-अक्ष के लम्बवत है। दीर्घवृत्त बिन्दुओं $(5,0)$ तथा $(-15,8)$ से होकर जाता है। तब दीर्घवृत्त की उत्केन्द्रता ______ है।
solution: Case $5(15+d)=17(5-d)$: $d=\dfrac{5}{11}$, $e=\dfrac{5}{50/11}=1.1>1$, not an ellipse (the points lie on opposite sides of the directrix)
solution_full: Let the directrix be $x=d$ ($d\neq0$, since the focus is not on the directrix). For every point $P$ of the ellipse, $PS=e\cdot PM$ with $S=(0,0)$ and $PM=|x-d|$.

Case $5(15+d)=17(5-d)$: $75+5d=85-17d$, $d=\dfrac{5}{11}$; then $e=\dfrac{5}{|5-5/11|}=\dfrac{11}{10}>1$. Here the two points are on opposite sides of the directrix, so this is a hyperbola, not an ellipse.
For the ellipse, $e=\dfrac{3}{5}$ with directrix $x=\dfrac{40}{3}$; both points and the focus lie on the same side of it, as they must for an ellipse.
originality_note: New: the directrix is unknown, so PS = e PM at two points gives a modulus equation with an ellipse branch and a hyperbola branch (way 3, a conic fixed by two conditions). Closest known: equation of a conic from its focus, directrix and eccentricity. Different because: e and the directrix are both unknown and the student must reject the e > 1 branch.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that only one branch gives an ellipse. Answer 0.6 is between 0 and 1 as planned. No change.
key_step: Apply PS = e PM at both points and choose the branch with e < 1.
justification: Two focus-directrix equations, a modulus split and a rejection; routine multi-step. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q4 (L2).
